Name: Collection Share
Author: Annny320
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
CollectionShare allows players to share and synchronize collection progress in Stardew Valley multiplayer, including Shipped Items, Fish, Artifacts, Minerals, and Cooking.

CollectionShare 是一款星露谷物语多人联机 Mod，用于在玩家之间共享和同步收藏进度，包括出货图鉴、钓鱼图鉴、古物图鉴、矿物图鉴和料理图鉴。

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI, then extract the CollectionShare folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Launch the game through SMAPI. All players who want to synchronize their collections must install the mod.

安装 SMAPI 后，将 CollectionShare 文件夹解压到 Stardew Valley 的 Mods 文件夹中，并通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。所有需要参与图鉴同步的玩家都需要安装本 Mod。[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Synchronize Shipped Items — 同步出货图鉴
• Synchronize Fish — 同步钓鱼图鉴
• Synchronize Artifacts — 同步古物图鉴
• Synchronize Minerals — 同步矿物图鉴
• Synchronize Cooking — 同步料理图鉴
• Configurable synchronization options — 可自定义同步项目
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support — 支持 GMCM（可选）[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI is required.
需要 SMAPI。

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Without GMCM, settings can be changed manually through config.json.
Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）为可选依赖。未安装 GMCM 时，可以通过 config.json 手动修改设置。[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to my friends for helping test the mod and providing resources and support throughout development. ❤️

特别感谢我的朋友们在开发过程中一起帮忙测试，并提供资源和支持。❤️[/color]
